--- tested-reference
+++ final-reference
@@ -21,7 +21,7 @@
 Before setting `feature.status` to `complete`, in this order:
 
 1. Inspect current requirements/tasks, decisions/fixes, source reconciliation, traceability and applicable verification results. Run the existing `validate-feature.py <PROJECT> <ID> --stage check` and `audit-delivery.py <PROJECT> <ID>`; inspect coverage and evidence, not only their success messages. Failed, missing or stale applicable evidence blocks completion. Reuse an actually current run when warranted; report writing alone does not justify repeating builds or tests.
-2. Write/update the local report from that evidence, then reread the saved file. Include feature ID; delivered HEAD and, for uncommitted code, worktree identity/diff or file hashes; requirement/task and decision/fix outcomes; actual check commands, test time/revision and coverage; manual/Agent/device evidence types, waivers, remaining limitations and the supported delivery conclusion. Distinguish historical runs from current evidence and writing time from test time. Preserve earlier failures and accepted-build history when updating; do not invent observer confirmation or retimestamp old results.
+2. Write/update the local report from that evidence, then reread the entire saved file (a header-only preview is insufficient). Include feature ID; delivered HEAD and, for uncommitted code, worktree identity/diff or file hashes; requirement/task and decision/fix outcomes; actual check commands, test time/revision and coverage; manual/Agent/device evidence types, waivers, remaining limitations and the supported delivery conclusion. Distinguish historical runs from current evidence and writing time from test time. Preserve earlier failures and accepted-build history when updating; do not invent observer confirmation or retimestamp old results.
 3. Compare the saved report with current inputs and results once more. If implementation, sources or authoritative meaning changed during closure, stop and return to the affected stage; do not relabel an old pass. Only when the report is saved, reviewed and consistent, and all completion conditions hold, update the existing feature status and regenerate its views. For controlled baselines also use the existing revision delivery-registration rules. Report the local path and actual remaining limits to the user.
 
 If blocked, retain a truthful partial report and `provisional` for the unfinished delivery; file existence alone is not acceptance. Status/help/questions remain read-only and do not create a report or change status without authorized closure. Legacy complete records are not bulk migrated by this rule. No commit, push, PR or archive is implied. These are Agent execution obligations using existing helpers; the structural validators do not prove the report's semantic truth or enforce this entire sequence.
